headline: Authorization to submit a Necessity of School Construction Stage I application to the RIDE School Building Authority, plus an executive session on potential litigation.
summary: Authorization to submit a Necessity of School Construction Stage I application to the RIDE School Building Authority is on the agenda. A possible executive session on potential litigation is also listed.
items: Authorization to execute and submit a Necessity of School Construction Stage I application to the RIDE School Building Authority, from the Building Subcommittee
Possible executive session on potential litigation, two discussions under RIGL § 42-46-5(a)(2)
If a closed meeting is held, vote to seal executive session minutes
Report out any votes subject to disclosure after returning to open session
location: Joseph Jenks Junior High School, 350 Division Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island 02860
